trap.label: enjoy/keep + -ing
trap.wrong: I enjoy to solve puzzles and I keep to try.
trap.right: I enjoy solving puzzles, and I keep trying.
trap.why: Em português “gosto de resolver” e “continuo tentando” usam infinitivo ou gerúndio indistintamente. Em inglês, enjoy e keep pedem -ing.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com enjoy: “I like solving puzzles.”
Reescreva com keep: “She continues to try.”
Dê um conselho: “You should practice daily.” (imperativo)
